c1-11-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Rights Nobody Can Take Away
c1-11-01.scenario: A friend asks what it means that human rights are 'inalienable'.
c1-11-01.prompt: Say that human rights are rights that, as such, nobody can take away.
cues: Use the 'rights that as such …' pattern
Say who cannot take them away
c1-11-01.target: Az emberi jogok olyan jogok, amelyek mint ilyenek senkitől nem vonhatók el.
c1-11-01.english: Human rights are rights that as such cannot be taken away from anyone.
c1-11-01.canDo: I can say that rights belong to everyone and cannot be taken away (*elidegeníthetetlen*).

c1-11-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Minorities in Hungary
c1-11-02.scenario: A friend asks what status national minorities have in Hungary.
c1-11-02.prompt: Say that the national minorities are constituent parts of the state and may use their mother tongue.
cues: Say what the minorities are in the state
Say what language right they have
c1-11-02.target: A nemzetiségek államalkotó tényezők. Joguk van az anyanyelvük használatára.
c1-11-02.english: The nationalities are constituent parts of the state. They have the right to use their mother tongue.
c1-11-02.canDo: I can say what status national minorities have in Hungary (*államalkotó tényező*).

c1-11-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Crimes That Never Lapse
c1-11-03.scenario: A friend asks whether war crimes can lapse after many years.
c1-11-03.prompt: Say that war crimes never lapse, so the perpetrators can be held to account later too.
cues: Say what that means for the perpetrators
c1-11-03.target: A háborús bűncselekmények el nem évülő bűncselekmények. Az elkövetőket később is felelősségre lehet vonni.
c1-11-03.english: War crimes are crimes that never lapse. The perpetrators can be held to account later too.
c1-11-03.canDo: I can name the main crimes of international law (*háborús bűncselekmény*, *emberiesség elleni bűncselekmény*).

c1-11-04.title: Communicative Challenge: From Treaty to Law
c1-11-04.scenario: A friend asks how an international treaty becomes part of Hungarian law.
c1-11-04.prompt: Say that the treaty is promulgated, and that a court reads domestic law in harmony with the convention.
cues: Say how the court reads domestic law
c1-11-04.target: A nemzetközi szerződést kihirdetik. A bíróságnak a hazai jogot az egyezménnyel összhangban kell értelmeznie.
c1-11-04.english: The international treaty is promulgated. The court must interpret domestic law in harmony with the convention.
c1-11-04.canDo: I can say how an international treaty becomes part of Hungarian law (*kihirdetés*).

c1-11-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Text Says About Guilt
c1-11-05.scenario: You have read a short text about Bibó István, and a friend asks what it says about guilt.
c1-11-05.prompt: Tell your friend what the text says about guilt and responsibility.
c1-11-05.target: A szöveg szerint bűnös csak az egyén lehet, de a társadalomnak felelősséget kell vállalnia.
c1-11-05.english: According to the text, only an individual can be guilty, but society must take responsibility.
c1-11-05.canDo: I can report what a text says about guilt and responsibility (*A szöveg szerint …*).

c1-11-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Rights and Responsibility
c1-11-consolidation.scenario: A friend asks what you remember from this unit.
c1-11-consolidation.prompt: Say that nobody can take human rights away, and that the text says society must take responsibility.
cues: Say what nobody can do with human rights
Say what the text says society must do
c1-11-consolidation.target: Az emberi jogokat senki sem veheti el. A szöveg szerint a társadalomnak felelősséget kell vállalnia.
c1-11-consolidation.english: Nobody can take human rights away. According to the text, society must take responsibility.
c1-11-consolidation.canDo: I can say that rights cannot be taken away and cannot be limited.
